providers.intro: VideoSOS generates through your own accounts: add a key of OpenRouter, fal or Runware. Keys stay on this computer and are never shown to agents.
providers.replace: Paste a new key to replace it
providers.agentHint: Past it, VideoSOS refuses an agent's generations for the rest of the day. Empty means no limit.
providers.confirmEdits: Agents' timeline edits wait for me
providers.confirmEditsHint: An agent's edit shows what will change, and nothing changes until you accept it.
providers.badBudget: The limit is a number of dollars.

assistantHint.agent: Improve prompt, Prompt from the picture, the storyboard's split, the 3D blocking and the Chat tab ask the agent connected to VideoSOS: it is a language model itself, so nothing more is paid. It answers while it listens (assistant_requests_wait).
assistantHint.openrouter: Improve prompt, Prompt from the picture, the storyboard's split, the 3D blocking and the Chat tab ask a model of OpenRouter, paid by your key.

providers.agentConnected: An agent is connected: it called {{seconds}} s ago.
providers.agentAbsent: No agent is connected now: connect one (below) and ask it to listen to VideoSOS's questions.
